# SM Legal — Marushkina Law Firm (Адвокатско дружество Марушкина)

> SM Legal is a business law firm in Sofia, Bulgaria, led by attorney-at-law Sylvia Marushkina (адв. Силвия Марушкина). It advises Bulgarian and foreign companies, start-ups, investors and individuals on corporate and commercial law, venture capital, employment and immigration (EU Blue Card, single permit), tax and VAT, compliance and AML, data protection (GDPR), intellectual property (trade marks in Bulgaria, the EU and under the Madrid System), real estate and dispute resolution. Advice is given in Bulgarian and English.

- Website: https://smlegal.bg/ (Bulgarian), https://smlegal.bg/en/ (English)
- Address: ул. „Добротица Деспот“ 41, 1612 София, България (41 Dobrotitsa Despot St., 1612 Sofia, Bulgaria)
- Phone: +359 898 648 762
- Email: smarushkina@smlegal.bg
- Office hours: Monday–Friday, 9:30–18:00 (EET)
- Languages: Bulgarian, English

## Practice areas (English)

- [Commercial and Corporate Law](https://smlegal.bg/en/practice-areas/corporate-commercial-law.html): company formation, share deals, M&A, due diligence, capital changes, liquidation
- [Venture Capital](https://smlegal.bg/en/practice-areas/venture-capital.html): funding rounds, term sheets, shareholders' agreements, convertible loans, ESOP
- [Start-ups and Technology](https://smlegal.bg/en/practice-areas/startups-technology.html): founders' agreements, SaaS and software contracts, terms of use, AI Act
- [Employment](https://smlegal.bg/en/practice-areas/employment-law.html): employment contracts, internal rules, terminations, hiring third-country nationals
- [Immigration](https://smlegal.bg/en/practice-areas/immigration-law.html): EU Blue Card, single permit, long-term and permanent residence, family reunification
- [Tax and VAT](https://smlegal.bg/en/practice-areas/tax-vat.html)
- [Compliance and AML](https://smlegal.bg/en/practice-areas/compliance-aml.html): AML rules, KYC, ultimate beneficial owners, whistleblowing, NIS2
- [Data Protection](https://smlegal.bg/en/practice-areas/data-protection-gdpr.html): GDPR policies, DPAs, DPIAs, data transfers
- [Intellectual Property](https://smlegal.bg/en/practice-areas/intellectual-property.html): trade mark registration in Bulgaria, EUIPO and WIPO (Madrid System), oppositions
- [Real Estate](https://smlegal.bg/en/practice-areas/real-estate.html): property due diligence, transactions, leases, acquisition by foreigners
- [Dispute Resolution](https://smlegal.bg/en/practice-areas/dispute-resolution.html): litigation, mediation, arbitration, debt collection
